S = [0,1,3]
for i in range(7):
    for s in S:

G.add_nodes_from(range(15))
G.add_edges_from(edges)
print("edges:", len(edges))
print("bipartite:", nx.is_bipartite(G))

    for cycle in nx.simple_cycles(G.to_directed()):

            min_cycle = min(min_cycle, len(cycle))
    print("girth:", min_cycle)
